The '''Bay of Eeronon''' was a small body of water on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aram]]. The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Talerakia]] was located on the shores of the bay.<ref name="Flashpoint" />
